questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: The area of a circle of radius 7 cm is
questions.solution: Area = πr² = 22/7 × 7 × 7 = 154 cm².

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: y varies directly as x. If y = 10 when x = 2, find y when x = 5.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Find the mode of 3, 5, 5, 7, 8, 5, 9.
questions.solution: The value occurring most frequently is 5.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: A point lies due South of another point. What is its bearing?
questions.solution: South corresponds to a bearing of 180°.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Solve for x: 2x - 5 = 11.
questions.solution: 2x - 5 = 11, so 2x = 16, therefore x = 8.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Find the value of 5².

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Evaluate log₁₀ 100.
questions.solution: log₁₀ 100 = log₁₀ 10² = 2.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: What is the probability of getting a head when a fair coin is tossed once?
questions.solution: A fair coin has 2 equally likely outcomes, so P(head) = 1/2.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: If U = {1,2,3,4,5,6}, A = {1,2,3} and B = {3,4,5}, find A ∪ B.
questions.solution: Union contains all elements in either set.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Simplify 2³ × 2⁴.
questions.solution: When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents: 2³ × 2⁴ = 2^(3+4) = 2⁷.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: The sum of angles in a triangle is
questions.solution: The interior angles of a triangle add up to 180°.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Find the 5th term of an arithmetic progression whose first term is 3 and common difference is 4.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Solve: x² - 9 = 0.
questions.solution: x² = 9. Therefore x = ±3.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: If A = {1,2,3,4} and B = {3,4,5,6}, find A ∩ B.
questions.solution: The intersection contains elements common to both sets.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Two angles of a triangle are 50° and 60°. Find the third angle.
questions.solution: The angles of a triangle sum to 180°, so the third angle = 180 - 50 - 60 = 70°.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Evaluate 5!.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: What is the area of a rectangle with length 12 cm and width 8 cm?
questions.solution: Area = Length × Width = 12 × 8 = 96 cm².

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Factorize x² - 9.
questions.solution: x² - 9 is a difference of two squares, which factorizes to (x-3)(x+3).

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Solve: 4y = 36.
questions.solution: 4y = 36, therefore y = 36 ÷ 4 = 9.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: The probability of obtaining a head when a fair coin is tossed once is
questions.solution: There are two equally likely outcomes: Head and Tail. P(Head) = 1/2.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Find the 10th term of the arithmetic sequence 3, 6, 9, 12, ...

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Find the area of a rectangle with length 8cm and width 5cm.
questions.solution: Area of a rectangle = length × width = 8 × 5 = 40cm².

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: How many ways can 3 students be selected from 5 students?

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Evaluate sin 30°.
questions.solution: sin 30° is a standard trigonometric value equal to 1/2.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: If y varies directly as x and y = 12 when x = 4, find y when x = 10.
questions.solution: y = kx. Since 12 = 4k, k = 3. Therefore y = 3 × 10 = 30.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Find the determinant of [ [2,1], [3,4] ].

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: If f(x) = 2x + 1, find f(3).

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Evaluate log₁₀(1000).
questions.solution: 10³ = 1000, therefore log₁₀(1000) = 3.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Find the value of sin 30°.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: What is the sum of the angles of a quadrilateral?
questions.solution: The interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to 360°.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: If the bearing of point A from point B is 070°, find the bearing of B from A.
questions.solution: The back bearing is found by adding 180° to the given bearing: 070° + 180° = 250°.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: A fair die is thrown once. What is the probability of obtaining an even number?
questions.solution: Even numbers are 2, 4, 6. Therefore probability = 3/6 = 1/2.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: If f(x) = 2x + 3, find f(4).

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Find the mean of the numbers 4, 8, 6, 10, 12.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Simplify √81.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: A ship sails due East from a port. Its bearing from the port is
questions.solution: East corresponds to a bearing of 090°.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Solve x² - 5x + 6 = 0.
questions.solution: x² - 5x + 6 factorizes to (x-2)(x-3) = 0, so x = 2 or x = 3.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: If 3x + 7 = 22, find the value of x.
questions.solution: 3x + 7 = 22, therefore 3x = 15 and x = 5.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Find the hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle whose other two sides are 3cm and 4cm.
questions.solution: By Pythagoras' theorem, hypotenuse² = 3² + 4² = 9 + 16 = 25, so hypotenuse = 5cm.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: The matrix A = [[1,2],[3,4]]. Find the element in the second row and first column.
questions.solution: The element in row 2 column 1 is 3.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: She has lived in Lagos _____ 2020.
questions.solution: 'Since' is used with a specific point in time, such as 2020.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: The manager is responsible _____ supervising the workers.
questions.solution: The correct expression is 'responsible for'.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: To 'spill the beans' means to _____
questions.solution: The idiom 'spill the beans' means to reveal secret or confidential information.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: She is good _____ solving difficult problems.
questions.solution: The correct expression is 'good at' followed by a noun or gerund.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: The news _____ very surprising.
questions.solution: 'News' is an uncountable singular noun and takes the singular verb 'was'.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to 'expand'.
questions.solution: 'Expand' means to become larger, while 'contract' means to become smaller.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: If I _____ you, I would apologize immediately.
questions.solution: The subjunctive mood requires 'were' after 'if I'.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to 'transparent'.
questions.solution: 'Transparent' means able to be seen through; the opposite is 'opaque'.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the word nearest in meaning to 'meticulous'.
questions.solution: 'Meticulous' means showing great attention to detail; careful.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: The students arrived _____ school before the teacher.
questions.solution: The correct preposition used with a specific place such as school is 'at'.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Each of the boys _____ given a prize.
questions.solution: 'Each' is singular and takes a singular verb, 'was'.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Neither of the answers _____ correct.
questions.solution: 'Neither' is treated as singular in this construction, so 'is' is correct.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: If she studies hard, she _____ the examination.
questions.solution: This is the first conditional: If + present simple, followed by 'will' + base verb.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Which sentence is in the passive voice?

options.c: The song was sung by the girl.

questions.solution: Passive voice places emphasis on the receiver of the action.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the word nearest in meaning to 'abundant'.
questions.solution: Abundant means existing in large quantities; plentiful.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.solution: 'Necessary' is the correctly spelt word.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: The word 'rapid' is closest in meaning to _____
questions.solution: 'Rapid' means happening quickly or at a fast rate.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: If someone is 'under the weather', the person is _____
questions.solution: The idiom 'under the weather' means feeling ill or unwell.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: A person who speaks many languages is called a _____
questions.solution: A polyglot is a person who knows or speaks several languages.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the sentence that is grammatically correct.

options.b: Neither John nor James has arrived.
options.c: Neither John nor James have arrived.
options.d: Neither John nor James are arriving.
options.e: Neither John nor James were arriving.

questions.solution: The verb agrees with the singular noun nearest to it.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the option that best expresses the sentence in the passive voice: 'He wrote the letter.'

options.b: The letter is written by him.
options.e: The letter was written by him.

questions.solution: The passive form of the past tense 'wrote' is 'was written'.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the option nearest in meaning to the underlined word. The chairman's decision was arbitrary.
questions.solution: Arbitrary means based on random choice rather than reason.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.solution: Pronunciation is the correct spelling.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: She _____ to school every day.
questions.solution: The singular subject 'She' takes 'goes'.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: The committee _____ divided in its opinion.
questions.solution: When a collective noun refers to members acting individually, a plural verb can be used. Here, 'are' emphasizes the members' differing opinions.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: The word 'obtain' is closest in meaning to _____
questions.solution: 'Obtain' means to get or acquire something.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: The teacher congratulated the student _____ her success.
questions.solution: The correct expression is 'congratulated someone on something'.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: What is the meaning of the idiom 'once in a blue moon'?
questions.solution: The idiom means something that happens very rarely.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Neither the teacher nor the students _____ aware of the change.
questions.solution: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the noun closest to it. 'Students' is plural, so 'were' is correct.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: By this time tomorrow, we _____ the examination.
questions.solution: The future perfect tense 'will have completed' describes an action that will be finished before a future time.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: By the time we arrived, the movie _____ already _____.
questions.solution: The past perfect tense 'had started' describes an action completed before another past action.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: The students as well as their teacher _____ attending the seminar.
questions.solution: The verb agrees with 'students'? No. With 'teacher' introduced by 'as well as' the main subject is 'students'? Actually 'students' is main subject. Better UTME style answer often 'are'.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: The principal asked the students whether they _____ completed their assignments.
questions.solution: In reported speech, the past perfect 'had completed' is appropriate because the action happened before the reporting action.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: The word 'generous' is closest in meaning to _____
questions.solution: A generous person is willing to give or share freely and is therefore kind-hearted.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: If something happens 'once in a blue moon', it happens _____
questions.solution: The idiom 'once in a blue moon' means something happens very rarely.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.solution: 'Occurrence' is the correctly spelt word, with double 'r' and double 'c'.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: By the time the guests arrived, she _____ the house.
questions.solution: The past perfect tense 'had cleaned' shows an action completed before another past event (the guests' arrival).

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'accurate'.
questions.solution: 'Accurate' means correct or free from errors.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: She has always been interested _____ music.
questions.solution: The correct expression is 'interested in'.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Neither the principal nor the teachers _____ present.
questions.solution: The verb agrees with the nearest subject, 'teachers'.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: I would rather _____ at home than go out tonight.
questions.solution: The expression 'would rather' is followed by the base form of the verb.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.solution: Accommodation is correctly spelt.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: If a task is described as 'a piece of cake', it means the task is _____
questions.solution: The idiom 'a piece of cake' means something that is very easy to do.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Had I known about the traffic, I _____ earlier.
questions.solution: This is a third conditional sentence referring to an unreal past situation.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: The word 'reluctant' is closest in meaning to _____
questions.solution: 'Reluctant' means unwilling or hesitant to do something.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: The word 'commence' is closest in meaning to _____
questions.solution: 'Commence' means to begin or start.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: The boys _____ football when it started raining.
questions.solution: The past continuous tense 'were playing' describes an action that was in progress when another action occurred.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to 'ancient'.
questions.solution: 'Ancient' refers to something very old, while 'modern' refers to something of the present or recent time.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: A person who deliberately sets fire to property is called an _____
questions.solution: An arsonist is a person who deliberately sets fire to buildings or other property.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
questions.solution: 'It's' is the contraction of 'it is', formed with an apostrophe.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the correct plural form of 'criterion'.
questions.solution: The plural of criterion is criteria.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the sentence with correct comma usage.

options.a: I bought apples oranges and bananas.
options.b: I bought apples oranges, and, bananas.
options.c: I bought, apples oranges and bananas.
options.d: I bought apples, oranges, and bananas.
options.e: I bought apples, oranges and, bananas.

questions.solution: Commas are used to separate items in a list, including before 'and' in the Oxford comma style.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Each of the players _____ given a new jersey.
questions.solution: 'Each' is singular, so it takes the singular verb 'was'.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: What is the plural form of 'phenomenon'?
questions.solution: 'Phenomenon' is an irregular noun whose plural form is 'phenomena'.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to 'arrogant'.
questions.solution: Arrogant means having an exaggerated sense of self-importance; the opposite is humble.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: A person who compiles dictionaries is called a
questions.solution: A lexicographer compiles dictionaries.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: The word 'diligent' means _____
questions.solution: A diligent person is hardworking and careful in carrying out tasks.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: To 'burn the midnight oil' means to _____
questions.solution: The idiom 'burn the midnight oil' means to study or work late into the night.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: Choose the opposite in meaning of 'expand'.
questions.solution: Contract means to reduce in size or shrink.

questions.subject: english-language
questions.question: By this time tomorrow, the athletes _____ the race.
questions.solution: The future perfect tense is used for an action completed before a future time.
